source_and_capability: Match the original source binding, current actor edit/view/non-partner access, actual registered attempt/origin-completion receipt, current exact document revision/object/version/hash/size/type, active rescan lease, its private capability and both reserved units. Caller echo of the copy hash is a fence, not physical byte attestation.
atomicity: Update only scan_status and the canonical updated_at revision. Insert the immutable private pending receipt in the same transaction and validate the actual stored RETURNING row. Skipped/altered source or receipt writes roll back both. Require a strictly later pending revision and a same-transaction tuple write witness. No capability is stored in the new receipt or returned again.
one_use: The first successful mutation returns a new transition receipt only. Duplicate/lost-reply paths cannot adopt an existing pending row, resume a claim or replay provider work. RPC/transaction commit confirmation remains required before any future external IO.
locks: Completion control/capacity fence before source binding, registered attempt/origin lease, document UPDATE, object SHARE, current lease/capacity locks. A prior claim can drain while paused; no fresh admission passes. Repeat current access after source locking; full transaction-held authority/legacy writer fencing remains a separate activation gate.
retention: Metadata-only immutable RESTRICT-linked receipt: operation/actor/document IDs, source/pending revisions, hash, transaction/timestamp. No names, document text, provider output, storage secrets or admission capabilities. xmin is used only as a same-transaction row-write witness, never permanent identity or provider/byte proof.
